description: NAS CG inverse-power iteration in FP64, standard classes S/W/A/B/C, full actual-result CPU verification and published zeta checks.

scaling_param.name: matrix_size
scaling_param.description: Matrix size selecting the complete standard NAS class S, W, A, B or C; class fixes sparsity, shift and iteration counts.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run one untimed vector-add warmer before the complete CG algorithm, intended to establish entry clock/cache conditions. Set false to skip it; no cache-state guarantee is implied.
